% A \thechapter set in the preamble of a memoir document, as a macro:
% chapters in Roman numerals, with a section, theorems, and equations
% numbered within them, references with hyperref, the table of contents,
% and appendix chapters, which \appendix letters again.
\documentclass{memoir}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\newcommand\theolchapter{\Roman{chapter}}
\def\thechapter{\theolchapter}
\newtheorem{proposition}{Proposition}[chapter]
\begin{document}
\tableofcontents*
\chapter{Start}\label{start}
\section{Basics}\label{basics}
\begin{proposition}
A first claim.
\end{proposition}
\begin{proposition}\label{prop}
A claim.
\end{proposition}
\begin{align}
x &= 0 \\
y &= 0
\end{align}
\begin{equation}
x = 1 \label{eq}
\end{equation}
Ref: \ref{start}; \ref{basics}; \ref{prop}; (\ref{eq}); \ref{second}; \ref{extra}; \ref{extrasec}.
\chapter{Second}\label{second}
Here \ref{second}.
\appendix
\chapter{Extra}\label{extra}
\section{More}\label{extrasec}
In the appendix, \ref{extra}; \ref{extrasec}.
\end{document}
